notes: every chart: chart._ssr false, env.node off (the tooltip view), 600 x 400 (the animations 400 x 300), the ECharts 6 palette at the root.
static cases: animation false; a paint (renderToSVGString) after setOption and after every step builds every path.
pointer steps go through zrender's Handler; a click is mousemove, mousedown, mouseup, click at one point.
Math.random is the port's xorshift32 from 2463534242, reset before every chart.
anim: animation.js' harness -- the Date hook, the samples, the element records.

cases.note: three nodes, three links: the defaults (padAngle 3, radius 70% / 80%, startAngle 90, labels outside)
six nodes, nine links, a self loop (D -> D): the self loop takes twice its value on D
padAngle 0: the sectors touch
padAngle 70 over six nodes: more than the turn, so padAngle takes what minAngle leaves
minAngle 20 and padAngle 5: a tiny node (D) borrows from the others in order until the deficit is met
every value nought, minAngle 90 over four nodes and one link: the deficit beats the surplus, every angle scaled
minAngle 80: a node that would fall under minAngle by its share lends as much as it can (surplusAsMuchAsPossible)
minAngle 120 over four nodes: more than the turn, so minAngle is cut to fit
clockwise false, startAngle 30
startAngle 0 and endAngle 180 (never read: a full turn), centre 40% / 55%, radius 30% / 45%, a box
startAngle -135, a single radius (r0 nought), centre in pixels
radius in pixels [100, 130], borderRadius 0 on the series

lineStyle.color 'gradient': a ribbon between two string colours is a global linear gradient across the two arcs' chords; a node coloured by a gradient object leaves its ribbons the prototype's '#000'; one link 'target'
per-link lineStyle: a literal colour fills '#000' and strokes, a width, an opacity, 'target'; the series' opacity 0.35
borderRadius 10 on the series, ["10%", 0] on one node, a border, an opacity, a colour
label position 'inside': the ring's middle, centred; one node's label right / top; one hidden; a template
distance 20 and a series template '{b} ({c})'; a node's own colour; a nameless node of a named series reads the SERIES' name (Model.get('name'))
an unnamed series of nameless nodes: the label is the data index; a label coloured inherit
labelLayout hideOverlap over twelve crowded nodes with long names: the label layout hides the later ones that collide
labels off on the series, one node on
every value nought: each link counts one, the angle by the number of link ends
a node's value past its links, a node with a value and no link, a link with no value (NaN restarts the next link's arc at 0), a link value '7'
`nodes` and `edges`: ids beat names, a numeric end is an index, a string end a key, a link to nowhere dropped
nodes and no links: the layout never runs, nothing is drawn
two chords side by side, the second clockwise false: the palette continues across them
a legend with B switched off: B and its links are gone, the layout redone, the colours kept
legend actions: C off, A toggled off, C back on
highlight a node and a link, focus 'adjacency' by default: the rest blurred
declared emphasis / blur styles: a node's emphasis colour, the links' emphasis lineStyle colour and opacity, blur opacities
labels hidden at rest, shown by the emphasis state: the text exists and only the state shows it
focus 'self' on the series, 'none' on one link, 'series' on one node
hover nodes and ribbons through the handler: emphasis, the adjacency blur, the tooltip; clicks on a node and a ribbon
a legend filtered B out: the links renumbered (dataIndex vs raw), hovered and clicked
nameless nodes and an unvalued node: the tooltip's empty name, the layout value
convertToPixel / convertFromPixel / containPixel on a chord: no coordinate system, nothing answers
a chord's enter: the view group scales from 0.01 about the centre (cubicOut, 1000 ms, no row), every label fades in at its node
the same, duration 600, quadraticIn, delay 100, a centre off the middle, labels inside
animationDelay (idx) => idx * 50: the group has no row, the labels have theirs
labels off: only the group scales
